		id = GEN_1970_foreign_policy_review
		icon = global_community

		x = 44
		y = 13

		cost = 5

		search_filters = { FOCUS_FILTER_INFLUENCE }

		completion_reward = {
			log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: Focus GEN_1970_foreign_policy_review"
			if = { limit = { has_government = democratic }
				every_country = {
					limit = {
						NOT = { has_government = fascism }
						NOT = { has_government = nationalist }
						NOT = { has_war_with = ROOT }
						has_opinion = { target = ROOT value > -25 }
						OR = {
							is_neighbor_of = ROOT
							has_government = democratic
						}
					}
					add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = political_outreach }
				}
			}
			else_if = { limit = { has_government = fascism }
				every_country = {
					limit = {
						NOT = { has_war_with = ROOT }
						has_opinion = { target = ROOT value > -25 }
						OR = {
							is_neighbor_of = ROOT
							has_government = fascism
						}
					}
					add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = political_outreach }
				}
			}
			else_if = { limit = { has_government = neutrality }
				every_country = {
					limit = {
						NOT = { has_government = fascism }
						NOT = { has_government = nationalist }
						NOT = { has_war_with = ROOT }
						has_opinion = { target = ROOT value > -25 }
						OR = {
							is_neighbor_of = ROOT
							has_government = neutrality
						}
					}
					add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = political_outreach }
				}
			}
			else_if = { limit = { has_government = communism }
				every_country = {
					limit = {
						NOT = { has_government = fascism }
						NOT = { has_war_with = ROOT }
						has_opinion = { target = ROOT value > -25 }
						OR = {
							is_neighbor_of = ROOT
							has_government = communism
						}
					}
					add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = political_outreach }
				}
			}
			else_if = { limit = { has_government = nationalist }
				every_country = {
					limit = {
						NOT = { has_government = fascism }
						NOT = { has_war_with = ROOT }
						has_opinion = { target = ROOT value > -25 }
						OR = {
							is_neighbor_of = ROOT
							has_government = nationalist
						}
					}
					add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = political_outreach }
				}
			}
			add_political_power = 50
		}

		ai_will_do = {
			base = 10
		}
	}

	focus = {
		id = GEN_1970_trade_with_the_neighbours
		icon = liberalization

		x = 1
		y = 1
		relative_position_id = GEN_1970_foreign_policy_review

		cost = 10

		prerequisite = { focus = GEN_1970_foreign_policy_review }

		search_filters = { FOCUS_FILTER_INFLUENCE }

		completion_reward = {
			log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: Focus GEN_1970_trade_with_the_neighbours"
			set_temp_variable = { percent_change = 0.5 }
			set_temp_variable = { tag_index = THIS.id }
			every_neighbor_country = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_war_with = ROOT }
					has_opinion = { target = ROOT value > -50 }
				}
				add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = improve_trade }
				set_temp_variable = { influence_target = THIS }
				change_influence_percentage = yes
			}
			custom_effect_tooltip = influence_on_neighbors_tt
			set_temp_variable = { temp_opinion = 5 }
			change_industrial_conglomerates_opinion = yes
			change_small_medium_business_owners_opinion = yes
			change_the_donju_opinion = yes
			change_chaebols_opinion = yes
			change_wall_street_opinion = yes
			if = { limit = { is_agrarian_economy = yes }
				set_temp_variable = { price_change = 3 }
				AGRI_price_change_all_crops = yes
				AGRI_update_math_variables = yes
			}
		}

		ai_will_do = {
			base = 10
		}
	}

	focus = {
		id = GEN_1970_expand_the_cities
		icon = construction_engineering

		x = 0
		y = 2
		relative_position_id = GEN_1970_national_development_plan

		cost = 7.86

		prerequisite = { focus = GEN_1970_railway_expansion focus = GEN_1970_highway_programme }

		search_filters = { FOCUS_FILTER_INDUSTRY }

		completion_reward = {
			log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: Focus GEN_1970_expand_the_cities"
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = 0 }
			random_owned_state = {
				limit = { state_population > 1000000 }
				add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 2
				add_to_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -2 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { all_owned_state = { state_population < 1000000 } }
				capital_scope = {
					add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 2
					add_to_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -2 }
				}
			}
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			if = { limit = { is_agrarian_economy = yes }
				set_temp_variable = { price_change = -7 }
				AGRI_price_change_all_crops = yes
				set_temp_variable = { temp_opinion = -12 }
				change_farmers_opinion = yes
				AGRI_update_math_variables = yes
			}
			else = {
				set_temp_variable = { temp_opinion = -10 }
				change_farmers_opinion = yes
			}
			set_temp_variable = { temp_opinion = 5 }
			change_small_medium_business_owners_opinion = yes
			change_industrial_conglomerates_opinion = yes
			change_international_bankers_opinion = yes
			change_oligarchs_opinion = yes
		}

		ai_will_do = {
			base = 10
		}

	focus = {
		id = GEN_1970_increase_resource_production
		icon = resource_extraction

		x = 0
		y = 4
		relative_position_id = GEN_1970_national_development_plan

		cost = 7.86

		prerequisite = { focus = GEN_1970_developmentalism }

		search_filters = { FOCUS_FILTER_EXPENDITURE }

		completion_reward = {
			log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: Focus GEN_1970_increase_resource_production"
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						has_idea = non_power
						has_idea = minor_power
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						any_owned_state = { has_resources_amount = { resource = oil amount > 0 } }
					}
					random_owned_state = {
						limit = { has_resources_amount = { resource = oil amount > 0 } }
						add_resource = { type = oil amount = 4 }
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						any_owned_state = { has_resources_amount = { resource = steel amount > 0 } }
					}
					random_owned_state = {
						limit = { has_resources_amount = { resource = steel amount > 0 } }
						add_resource = { type = steel amount = 4 }
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						any_owned_state = { has_resources_amount = { resource = aluminium amount > 0 } }
					}
					random_owned_state = {
						limit = { has_resources_amount = { resource = aluminium amount > 0 } }
						add_resource = { type = aluminium amount = 4 }
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						any_owned_state = { has_resources_amount = { resource = tungsten amount > 0 } }
					}
					random_owned_state = {
						limit = { has_resources_amount = { resource = tungsten amount > 0 } }
						add_resource = { type = tungsten amount = 4 }
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						all_owned_state = { has_resources_amount = { resource = oil amount < 1 } }
						all_owned_state = { has_resources_amount = { resource = steel amount < 1 } }
						all_owned_state = { has_resources_amount = { resource = aluminium amount < 1 } }
						all_owned_state = { has_resources_amount = { resource = tungsten amount < 1 } }
					}
					capital_scope = { add_resource = { type = steel amount = 6 } }
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						has_idea = regional_power
						has_idea = large_power
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						any_owned_state = { has_resources_amount = { resource = oil amount > 0 } }
					}
					random_owned_state = {
						limit = { has_resources_amount = { resource = oil amount > 0 } }
						add_resource = { type = oil amount = 6 }
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						any_owned_state = { has_resources_amount = { resource = steel amount > 0 } }
					}
					random_owned_state = {
						limit = { has_resources_amount = { resource = steel amount > 0 } }
						add_resource = { type = steel amount = 6 }
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						any_owned_state = { has_resources_amount = { resource = aluminium amount > 0 } }
					}
					random_owned_state = {
						limit = { has_resources_amount = { resource = aluminium amount > 0 } }
						add_resource = { type = aluminium amount = 6 }
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						any_owned_state = { has_resources_amount = { resource = tungsten amount > 0 } }
					}
					random_owned_state = {
						limit = { has_resources_amount = { resource = tungsten amount > 0 } }
						add_resource = { type = tungsten amount = 6 }
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						all_owned_state = { has_resources_amount = { resource = oil amount < 1 } }
						all_owned_state = { has_resources_amount = { resource = steel amount < 1 } }
						all_owned_state = { has_resources_amount = { resource = aluminium amount < 1 } }
						all_owned_state = { has_resources_amount = { resource = tungsten amount < 1 } }
					}
					capital_scope = { add_resource = { type = steel amount = 10 } }
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						has_idea = great_power
						has_idea = super_power
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						any_owned_state = { has_resources_amount = { resource = oil amount > 0 } }
					}
					random_owned_state = {
						limit = { has_resources_amount = { resource = oil amount > 0 } }
						add_resource = { type = oil amount = 10 }
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						any_owned_state = { has_resources_amount = { resource = steel amount > 0 } }
					}
					random_owned_state = {
						limit = { has_resources_amount = { resource = steel amount > 0 } }
						add_resource = { type = steel amount = 10 }
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						any_owned_state = { has_resources_amount = { resource = aluminium amount > 0 } }
					}
					random_owned_state = {
						limit = { has_resources_amount = { resource = aluminium amount > 0 } }
						add_resource = { type = aluminium amount = 10 }
					}

						any_owned_state = { has_resources_amount = { resource = tungsten amount > 0 } }
					}
					random_owned_state = {
						limit = { has_resources_amount = { resource = tungsten amount > 0 } }
						add_resource = { type = tungsten amount = 10 }
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						all_owned_state = { has_resources_amount = { resource = oil amount < 1 } }
						all_owned_state = { has_resources_amount = { resource = steel amount < 1 } }
						all_owned_state = { has_resources_amount = { resource = aluminium amount < 1 } }
						all_owned_state = { has_resources_amount = { resource = tungsten amount < 1 } }
					}
					capital_scope = { add_resource = { type = steel amount = 15 } }
				}
			}
			# Agricultural economy effects
			if = { limit = { is_agrarian_economy = yes }
				set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = { value = gdp_total multiply = -0.005 } }
				modify_treasury_effect = yes
				set_temp_variable = { AGRI_protections_change = 1 }
				AGRI_protection_update = yes
				set_temp_variable = { allocation_change = -0.05 }
				AGRI_shift_crop_allocation = yes
				set_temp_variable = { temp_opinion = 2 }
				change_farmers_opinion = yes
				AGRI_update_math_variables = yes

			change_industrial_conglomerates_opinion = yes
			change_small_medium_business_owners_opinion = yes
			change_the_donju_opinion = yes
			change_chaebols_opinion = yes
			change_wall_street_opinion = yes
			change_fossil_fuel_industry_opinion = yes
			change_oligarchs_opinion = yes
			change_defense_industry_opinion = yes
			change_landowners_opinion = yes
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = { value = gdp_total multiply = -0.001 } }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
		}

		ai_will_do = {
			base = 10
		}
